longDescription: Fourteen workflows for developers working with a coding agent: turn an idea into a small project plan, check progress, recover chat goals and decisions, review exposure and legal questions, assess release readiness, draft change notes from evidence, and finish with a clear handoff. Choose one naming style per installation. Runs locally; repository checks may need Git, Python 3.10+ and optional scanners. No hooks or MCP server are included. Findings are not security or legal certification. External actions require authorization. Also includes evidence-based retrospectives, returning after a long pause, manual prompt completion and paired Plain/Kitchen naming. Includes an introduction that explains the collection and recommends a fitting workflow. Includes autonomous goal execution with verification and critique, while preserving product intent.
capabilities: Understand Cookbook and choose a workflow
Execute a project goal and verify the actual result
defaultPrompt: Help me plan a small portfolio website with three projects.
Evaluate this repository for release readiness without publishing.
Draft release notes from the actual diff between the supplied Git refs.
